note: Independent rejudge of the current twelve tagged units after correcting ordinary eBGP Auto expectations and adding explicit single-Link-Local coverage. Section 4 item 3 says: Link-Local IPv6 next hops MUST NOT be included. The surrounding condition is an external peer multiple IP hops away. The two configured-Self units cover common-subnet exclusion and its directly attached control. The four existing received-pair units cover both forwarding paths: Unchanged removes the received Link-Local half while retaining the received Global; ordinary eBGP Auto emits its own usable Global; attached Unchanged recipients retain the complete pair. The recipient fixtures explicitly are not route-server clients. The earlier six-unit set alone did not cover the separate received sixteen-octet Link-Local-only branch, so its previous whole-row assurance could not simply be refreshed. The six new rail-specific units now cover that branch without relying on an impossible explicit-Link-Local configuration. ReceivedMultihopCached and ReceivedMultihopNative first advertise a usable Global, require the exact prefix withdrawal with no announcement when received Link-Local-only input replaces it, then require explicit-Self recovery. PolicyMultihopCached and PolicyMultihopNative drive the real export-library FilterModify.Raw path with Global, Link-Local-only and restored Global output, asserting each actual socket result. AttachedCached and AttachedNative preserve exact single-Link-Local bytes and prefix with no withdrawal for both received and raw-policy input. The fixture supplies capability-77 permission before dispatch, explicitly checks ordinary eBGP and connected scope, and restores the immutable scope after the policy helper refreshes host interfaces; this isolates the scope rule from independent capability refusal or blanket dropping. egressNextHopLinkLocalOnlyOffLink tests connected scope before the effective rewritten or borrowed next-hop entity, and egressNextHopWithheld applies it on both forward paths. The twelve-unit population therefore covers configured self, received pairs, received single-Link-Local and reachable raw-policy single-Link-Local output, with distinct permitting controls and preserved useful advertisements. Retain enforced on this source-supported scope.
